title: Deck Tome
pitch: Describe the deck you want, answer a few questions, and get a legal Magic: The Gathering deck.
highlights: A rules engine checks every card for legality on the day, color identity, power bracket, and ownership before you see the deck.
I direct AI coding agents. Every change goes on a branch, gets an automated code review and a full CI run, and waits for me to merge.
I keep a dated, public decision register: 721 decisions in the first 23 days.
